phrases.english: Outside the windows it was drizzling

phrases.latin: Lēniter tantum pluit; umbellā nōn est opus.
phrases.english: It’s only drizzling; we don’t need the umbrella.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 135, 307.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
